Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 146. Category: technique. Rank 4.

Rank 4 Ki technique
Ki Cost: 35 ki
Prerequisites: 1 Star in Burning Attack
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: 60 feet
Chargeable?: Yes
Duration: Instantaneous
Type: Blast
Make a large ki ball at your side before launching it at
highspeed toward the opponent.
Roll a Blast Attack Roll dealing your Basic Ki Blast
Damage Die + 6d12 fire damage on a hit.
